facts: Appropriate user modeling is addressed to generate cooperative responses to each user in spoken dialogue systems.
The proposed user model is more comprehensive than previous studies.
Previous studies focus on user's knowledge.
Previous studies focus on typical kinds of users.
Skill level to the system is a dimension of user models.
Knowledge level on the target domain is a dimension of user models.
The degree of hastiness is a dimension of user models.
The models are automatically derived by decision tree learning.
The models are derived using real dialogue data collected by the system.
Classification accuracy is reasonable for all dimensions.
Dialogue strategies based on the user modeling are implemented in Kyoto city bus information system.
Dialogue strategies are based on the user modeling.
Cooperative responses adaptive to individual users serve as good guidance for novice users.
Cooperative responses adaptive to individual users do not increase the dialogue duration for skilled users.
